notes.title: May update; Magic & Mystery Collab
notes.notes:
Hello! I hope you've been well!

I'm just popping in with a quick progress update on the extended demo. Currently all the music and writing is finished; I'm now busy with the art, sound and coding.

Along with several new CGs, I'm also reworking some of the old CGs and backgrounds to look more cohesive and polished. Because the original demo was made in <1 month for a jam, I had to leave some of the current artwork on the rougher side.

Here's a little peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913634/75a67984ef10510ef538c5a87fdd629559c2c590.png[/img]

If you'd like to be notified directly when the demo drops, [url=https://endysis.net/newsletter]sign up for my newsletter here![/url]

[h3]A Summer Spell of Magic & Mystery[/h3]

[previewyoutube=dcM6dLqSJdc;full][/previewyoutube]

In other news, Snow White Ashes is taking part in a bundle with other magical otome games this summer! If you're looking for something to play while waiting for the demo update, scroll down to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811620/Snow_White_Ashes/]Magic & Mystery[/url] section on the store page for links to other games to check out!
